cohort: Pregnant patients with symptoms suggestive of intrahepatic cholestasis at Combined Military Hospital, Kharian, Pakistan, from October 2013 to March 2014, excluding those with cholestasis due to other reasons, coagulopathies, thrombocytopenia, and tumors.
finding: The frequency of intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy was 3.1% (31/1001) and it was associated with significant maternal and fetal health impacts.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the mode of delivery in 58% of patients with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy.
